_about: Public-domain F. J. A. Hort (Fenton John Anthony Hort, 1828-1892, Cambridge) for the Word Hoard: The Epistle of St James (1909) from CCEL, and from Internet Archive scans Two Dissertations (1876), The Way the Truth the Life (Hulsean Lectures 1871, 1897 printing), Judaistic Christianity (1894), Prolegomena to Romans and Ephesians (1895), Six Lectures on the Ante-Nicene Fathers (1895), Village Sermons (two series), The Christian Ecclesia (first edition 1897), Cambridge and Other Sermons (1898), First Epistle of St Peter (1898), Notes on the Clementine Recognitions (1901) and The Apocalypse of St John I-III (1908). Most are posthumous, edited by others. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 20 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
